d: John Becker has insomnia and the gang tries to help him get through it. (TV-PG)
John runs into an old college mentor/professor who doesn't remember him. This torments John who tries to get the professor to remember him. (TV-PG)

John hopes for a reconciliation with his ex-wife when she announces her desire for another child.
John reneges on his promise to help Wendy have a baby by artificial means.
Kirk and his brother, a priest, feud over a woman.
New club member Jason romances both Kate and Louise; John makes a visit to the gym.

Roy sees red, white and blue when she hears a rap artist sing a non-conventional version of the National Anthem at a baseball game. On a dare, he agrees to belt out his own rendition at a Red Sox game.

Helen plants a kiss on Lowell's cheek after he fixes her stove and the lonely handyman is instantly smitten. Lowell asks Helen for a date and, after initially turning him down, Helen reluctantly accepts his dinner invitation.

Antonio learns an important lesson in friendship when Lowell and his sidekick, Tucker (guest star Tracey Walter), invite Antonio to join them for a night of beer drinking and rat shooting at the dump.

st: It's So Nice To Have A Mather Around The House
d: After Brian finally convinces Alex (guest star Farrah Forke) to go out with him, he then persuades Lowell to let him borrow his boat for the night. Unfortunately, his plans of passion turn to mayhem when the boat is hit by a cabin cruiser and sinks.
Brian learns the importance of self-respect after Cupid's arrow misfires, turning him into an eager lap dog for an old high school flame.
